_about: Pipeline tools and the programs they call. Hooks and scheduled tasks call 'resolve.ps1 run <role>'.

root-topology-gate.note: FAILS when the visible project root holds anything but the twelve stages, or a root-tool-folders item is not Hidden; package-gate runs it (gate-rules row root-holds-only-the-twelve-stages) - 2026-10-27

line17-gate.note: FAILS when a Skyrim SKSE DLL package ships no Line-17 build and its repo's CommonLib cannot read 1.7.x; package-gate runs it (gate-rules row skse-dll-package-ships-line-17) - 2026-11-07

compat-evidence-gate.note: --path <package>: the mod's latest stage-8 compatible verdict must name evidence that still exists (batch, test request or record file); legacy verdicts without a reference pass as LEGACY; gate-rules row compat-verdict-evidence-exists - pipeline assessment item 2b, 2026-10-27

gate-catalogue.note: --build / --check of scripts\GATE-CATALOGUE.md: every gate-rules row (stage, scope, last fired from the event log) and every standalone gate script (callers), with the never-fired and finalize-only candidates; gate-rules-index.py --build rebuilds it - pipeline assessment item 11, 2026-10-27

profile-list-write-gate.note: refuses a whole modlist.txt / plugins.txt written from a saved copy: PreToolUse-hook mode (stdin), --scan of tool source (the .MD pre-commit hook runs it on staged tools; gate-rules row no-whole-list-restore-in-pipeline-tools) - pipeline assessment item 2, 2026-10-27

package-render-gate.note: REFUSES posting a model mod (package ships .nif) without a current, passing package render for exactly the finalized package's NIF/DDS hashes; nexus-upload.py runs it before anything is sent - 2026-11-12

md-scripts-render.note: the render pipeline's own tools: niflib, winding, the NIF read-back, render_lib and the before/after sheet (promoted from the Truly Nordic repos 2026-11-18)

niflib.note: our own minimal SSE NIF block reader/writer (no third-party code); one copy, promoted 2026-11-18 from the identical copies in the Nordic Ebony / Skyforged repos

nif-winding.note: face-direction check of a game NIF (niflib + numpy): edges against a neighbour, surfaces facing in (ray vote)

nif-readback.note: FAILS a built NIF on bad refs, skinned-flag mismatch, unresolved texture paths, lost UVs / broken tangents, smoothed hard edges, see-through, winding (--tex-prefix names our shapes); no Blender - 2026-11-18

render-lib.note: game-like TruePBR / classic Blender renders of NIFs (needs Blender + PyNifly, installed by the person); same_frame groups share one camera

before-after-sheet.note: the before/after (or original / marks / result) side-by-side review sheet; 'render' renders both NIFs with one camera (SKIP, exit 3, without Blender)

post-release-prune.note: keeps the current release and one previous in 10. finalized mods (rule 23) and prunes the mod's test builds; version-gate.ps1 -Action posted runs it after the ledger write (2026-10-13, straight flow B)

test-build-pick.note: dot-sourced: which of several test-build folders of one version is the build (the one whose artefact matches the ledger's working hash); used by finalize-mod, version-gate and pre-finalize-check (2026-10-13)

problem-card.note: the PROBLEM CARD (rule 56, amended 2026-11-16): new --task T [--area A] writes a skeleton to role problem-cards; check <card> refuses (exit 3) a card missing INPUTS (each with source:), RELATIONSHIPS, OUTPUT, CHECK or ASSUMPTIONS; falsification-log open -Card runs it

ask-glimmer.note: retired 2026-11-05 with glimmer-agent: Muse Glimmer and LM Studio are gone; one-shot text jobs go to Claude sub-agents as sub-agent-routing.md decides; roles are never reused

resolve.note: the resolver itself; its own path is the one fixed literal (hooks call it)

gate-ledger-tool.note: rule 58's verdict ledger tool (record / resolve / stats / list); role gate-ledger is its JSON (2026-10-12)

behavior-patch-enum-gate.note: package gate (row behavior-patch-enum-values-are-the-class-own): fails a behaviour patch node whose selfTransitionMode / startStateMode / eventMode is not a value of its own class (Simple Dodge 1.2.0, 2026-11-12)

clip-motion-matches-motion-data-gate.note: package gate (row clip-motion-matches-motion-data): fails a clip whose own animmotion annotations disagree with its clip generator's motion data, in Common and under each installer option - Animation Motion Revolution uses the annotations (Simple Dodge 1.2.0, 2026-11-13)

patternlib-cli.note: patternlib's command line: <spec.json> <out dir> -> pattern.json + .svg + height / normal / preview PNGs + validation.json + the engraving-layout record; exit 2 when a validator refuses (REFUSED <validator>: ...)

pattern-gate.note: FAILS a saved patternlib pattern (pattern.json, re-validated at its ppu) or a work folder whose engraving_check.json layouts name generator patternlib with a refused verdict; the engraving-layout gate also refuses a patternlib record whose verdict is not ok - 2026-11-16

patternlib-catalogue.note: writes PATTERNS-sheet.png: every patternlib pattern type at three densities with its validator verdict printed under it
